main.description: An operations/maintenance (運用メンテナンス) verdict for one DEPLOYED lifeline asset (ADR-2606280900), computed from its physical-simulation twin (condition/RUL/safety). The lifecycle gate routes the asset to a maintenance action and an EXECUTOR (kuni-umi build/commission fleet / tazuna teleop inspection / giemon repair arm / noroshi fibre splice / hodoki disassembly + kanayama material recovery) and imputes OpEx onto the §1.16 non-profit rails — cash ≡ 0 to the consumer (upkeep is never billed, G2). SAFETY FLOOR: an unsafe asset is never deferred for cost (G9). DESIGN ONLY — iriai plans the maintenance; the executor acts under Council Lv7+ (actuation-class :intent, G5).

verdict.description: the maintenance lifecycle decision (SAFETY FLOOR first — an unsafe asset is :corrective-repair or :decommission, never deferred)

reason.description: present when the verdict is forced by safety or end-of-life

executor.description: which actor carries the action (iriai plans; the executor acts under Council)

opexUsd.description: imputed annual upkeep OpEx ×100 (fixed-point); §1.16 in-kind, cash ≡ 0 to consumer

cashToConsumer.description: G2 — upkeep is never billed to the lifeline consumer

actuationClass.description: G5 — design only; live upkeep is the executor's cell under Council Lv7+ + operator-DID + member-sig
